title: Ledger balances drift by one cent

crosscheck.reference: manual ASCII-digit parse of whole/fraction to exact cents, then net per account

cases.name: v4:no_rounding_drift
cases.code:
amounts = ['0.29', '4.35', '1.10', '8.87', '2.67', '0.07', '1.15', '70.07', '1.00']
out = []
for a in amounts:
    b = sol.compute_balances([{'from': 'x', 'to': 'y', 'amount': a}])
    out.append((a, b['y']))
result = out
